name: 楊哲化
objective:
先修課程：負責教授同意。1. 超音波技術簡介 2. 基礎彈性力學 3. 彈性動力學 4. 平面波 5. 平面波的反射 6. 平面波的折射 7. 表面波 8. 藍姆波 (平板波) 9. 超音波於非破壞檢測之應用 10. 超音波於材料性質量測之應用 11. 超音波於醫學診斷與治療之應用 12. 超音波於感測器及通訊應用之應用 13. 超音波於加工應用之應用
1.Introduction to ultrasonics 2.Basic elasticity for ultrasonics 3.Elastodynamics 4.Plane waves 5.Reflection of plane waves 6.Refraction of plane waves 7.Surface waves 8.Lamb waves 9.Ultrasonics in nondestructive testing 10.Application of ultrasonics to material characterizations 11.Application of ultrasonics in medical diagnostics and treatments 12.Application of ultrasonics to sensors and telecommunications 13.Application of ultrasonics to machining
schedule:
1 9/10 Introduction of ultrasonics
2 9/17 Stress and Strain
3 9/24 Stress and Strain, Constitutive equations
4 10/1 Equations of elastodynamics
5 10/8 Plane Waves
6 10/15 Harmonic Waves
7 10/22 Reflection of plane waves
8 10/29 Midterm Exam
9 11/5 Fist Project Presentation
10 11/12 Refraction of plane waves
11 11/19 Surface waves (1)
12 11/26 Surface waves (2)
13 12/3 Lamb waves (1)
14 12/10 Lamb waves (2)
15 12/17 Final Project Presentation
16 12/24 Final Exam
17 12/31 Ultrasound applications with AI
18 1/7 Ultrasound applications with ChatGDP
materials:
【遵守智慧財產權觀念，請使用正版教科書，不得使用非法影印教科書】



Textbook: B. A. Auld, Acoustic Fields and Waves in Solids, (Robert E. Krieger Publishing, Malabar, Florida, 1990)
延伸教學與資源:
● 數位科技融入 (Digital Technology Integration)
運用生成式 AI、VR/AR、IoT、IRS 等新興科技輔助教學與評量。
Utilizes emerging technologies such as Generative AI, VR/AR, IoT, and IRS (Interactive Response Systems) to facilitate teaching and assessment.
課程對應SDGs指標:
SDG7：可負擔的潔淨能源（Affordable and Clean Energy）
SDG8：尊嚴就業與經濟發展（Decent Work and Economic Growth）
SDG9：產業創新與基礎設施（Industry, Innovation and Infrastructure）
SDG13：氣候行動（Climate Action）
課程是否導入AI:
● 使用生成式 AI 作為教學過程的輔助工具（Use generative AI tools as an aid to the teaching process）
● 鼓勵學生使用生成式 AI 工具（Encourage students to use generative AI tools）
